# Msg91

MSG91 is a cloud communication platform offering secure and robust APIs for SMS, WhatsApp, Email, Voice, and more, enabling businesses to connect with their customers across multiple channels.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/msg91/.

## Actions

- **Create User Events**: Create user events in msg91 segmento.
- **Get Event Types**: Retrieve all available event types in segmento.
- **Get Failed Events**: Retrieve failed segmento events.
- **List Campaigns**: List all campaigns in segmento.
- **Send SMS**: Send sms messages.
